noticeRules.1: Before pickup, inspect the vehicle/battery status and confirm the item is in good condition and working order.
noticeRules.2: Only the person who placed the order may pick up the item; proxy pickup is not supported.
noticeRules.3: Damage to the vehicle/battery will be compensated at the actual repair cost.
noticeRules.4: Please comply with local traffic regulations and ride safely.
noticeRules.5: Inventory is subject to on-site store stock; we recommend contacting the store in advance to confirm or consult.

orders.selfPickupReturn: Pick up & return at the store by yourself
orders.returnReminder: 7 days left in the rental period, please return to the store on time

billingRules.1: Billing starts when the user picks up the vehicle/battery and ends when the vehicle/battery is fully returned.
billingRules.2: Periodic rent is calculated based on the rental plan selected for the order.
billingRules.3: If the rental duration is less than one billing period, it is charged as one period.

overdueRules.1: Please return the vehicle/battery within the return time agreed in the order.
overdueRules.2: In case of overdue return, the merchant may deduct the related overdue charges from the deposit.
overdueRules.3: If the deposit is insufficient to cover the deduction, the merchant has the right to claim the difference from the user.
overdueRules.4: If the vehicle is not returned beyond the agreed number of days, the merchant has the right to remotely lock the vehicle.

cancelRules.1: If the order has not been paid, the user may cancel it on their own.
cancelRules.2: If the order has been paid but the vehicle/battery has not been picked up, the user may cancel it on their own.
cancelRules.3: After picking up the vehicle/battery, cancellation requires negotiation with the merchant; the actual refund is subject to the agreement between both parties.
cancelRules.4: Rent and deposit will be refunded via the original payment method within 7 business days after the order is canceled.
